name: cost-routing-gate
description: PreToolUse Edit/Write/Bash gate that enforces /ship-feature cost routing during a fresh live run. In-session source writes inside the run worktree BLOCK and route to out-of-process codex exec. Conservative deploy/poll-loop Bash inside the run worktree BLOCKs and routes to out-of-process claude --model haiku -p. No fresh marker, stale markers, unscopable markers, unrelated worktrees, ordinary Bash, crashes, and COST_ROUTING_GATE_OFF=1 PASS/fail open.

input.Bash: PreToolUse payload with tool_input.command and cwd

output.target: resolved file path or Bash cwd

blocked_edit_write: non-docs, non-markdown paths inside a fresh marker's valid worktree/cwd/repo
blocked_bash: railway up or railway redeploy paired with while/until+sleep or repeated status/watch polling
bare while/until loops containing both sleep and a status/poll command
known_limitations: Bash deploy-loop blocking requires the PreToolUse payload to expose cwd. If cwd is absent, the Bash side fails open by design; Edit/Write source blocking remains the primary teeth.
Fresh markers with no existing worktree/cwd/repo field cannot be path-scoped and therefore PASS.
The Bash signature is intentionally conservative; ambiguous commands PASS to avoid blocking benign one-shot Bash.
litmus: During a fresh /ship-feature run, is this in-session tool call doing Codex implementation or Haiku deploy-watch work inside the run worktree? If yes, BLOCK and route out of process; if no, PASS.
origin: XOS-206, 2026-07-04 - turn prose cost-routing guidance into a hard PreToolUse gate for /ship-feature execution leaks.
